about: The research so far behind a hazard that has no damage curve, in this repository or in Hazard's. One entry per document; 'asset' is an asset slug or '*' for every asset; 'finding' is the document's own conclusion, kept short and quoted or closely paraphrased from it. The build checks every path and links it where it is (Damage: this repository; Hazard: its main, else the branch that holds it).

entries.title: Damage's scope: a damage curve prices physical destruction only
entries.finding: Heat is treated as changing how an asset performs (derating, ageing), which sits outside a damage curve; disruption and derating are a separate stage.

entries.title: BESS heat: physical effects and first-screen feasibility (Hazard, 21 Oct 2026)
entries.finding: Heat can cause lasting physical harm to batteries (an EPRI field case, LFP lab studies), but the reviewed sources do not yet support an outdoor-temperature-to-repair-cost curve for the reference plant.

entries.title: Heat: define the consequence before building the model (Hazard, 21 Oct 2026)
entries.finding: Parked by the owner on 21 Oct: temporary derating, permanent ageing and acute failure need separate definitions, and working cooling should be compared with impaired cooling. No owner ruling yet.
